ghidra: read-only for this packet; names recorded in the ledger only
headline: The ocean, rain and effect-manager slice of BSP_Game_OnMove. game+19E8h is an owner whose +3Ch is the ocean object; its tick re-orthogonalises a basis against the reference node's matrix row at +110h and spends the frame delta only inside the shore-wave layers, where each layer accumulates scroll += direction * delta * speed * 30.0f. game+19FCh is a scene transform, not an effect list: it is the reference node both the ocean and the effect manager read. The one-shot at game+1EE7h does not arm anything ocean-related; 004B6260 tests the network session at game+1EF0h and 004BCAA0 bumps two mission counters at game+740h/+73Ch.
source_of_truth: BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4a40 has an eight-byte Ghidra body; every OnMove listing quoted came from `python tools/bsp.py disasm-raw 004e4a40 --length 2808`. Callee facts involving x87, register inputs or conditional-move idioms came from `bsp.py ghidra disasm`, not from pseudocode.

map_corrections.correction: 004D1100 takes no arguments. It is a locked lazy singleton getter caching into 00F8765C via BSP_SingletonLifetime_GetManager, operator new(0x28), 004CF700 and BSP_SingletonLifetime_Register. The two pushes at 004e536b/004e536c belong to 00867EE0, which consumes them with RET 8; that is why no `add esp` appears between the calls.

map_corrections.claim: docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md line 70 records the one-shot as `004b6260()`.
map_corrections.correction: 004B6260 is __thiscall with ECX = game+1EF0h (the network session subobject, the same one the network tick 00778560 and the drain loop 00776230 use), while 004BCAA0 runs with ECX = the game object.

map_corrections.claim: The packet contract calls game+1EE7h the one-shot that arms the ocean and effect updates.
map_corrections.correction: Neither routine touches game+19E8h, game+19FCh, the ocean or any effect. The latch is a once-per-mission session statistic that shares the state-0Dh block. The ocean and effect updates are gated only by game+19E8h != 0 and by the simulation gate.

behavior.00865ab0: Returns unless descriptor+38h holds an emitter. Reads game+19FCh twice from DAT_00E188A8, refreshes the world matrix on each read when node+5Ch bit 1 is clear, copies node+120h..128h into a local, and calls 00801400 with ECX = descriptor+38h and (game+21F0h, &worldPosition, node+110h). The delta is fetched from the global game object by this routine, not passed down from OnMove.
behavior.00801400: Gates on delta * DAT_00D04368 * (DAT_00F87470 * DAT_00D7A220) < 00BD2F10(), then refreshes the same node and requires node+124h > 0.0 (world Y above zero) before calling 004845D0, 00867B10 and 008687C0. Reads as the ambient rain emitter; 00BD2F10's range decides whether the comparison is a probability gate or its inverse.
behavior.00bbd310_disabled: ocean+98h == 0 runs 00B6DA70(ECX = ocean+30h, 0.0f, 0), which writes the float into node+ACh and does not recurse because the second argument is zero. No frame field is touched.
00bbd310_enabled: refresh the reference node's world matrix when node+5Ch bit 1 is clear
t1 = cross(V, up); t2 = cross(t1, V); up = normalize(t2)  (Gram-Schmidt against V)
if (length(up) < 0.5f) reset up = (0,1,0) and right = (1,0,0); the tested value is a normalize result so it is exactly 1.0f or 0.0f
for i in [0, ocean+1Ch): 00BBE8B0(ECX = layers[i], node, ocean+38h, ocean+34h, 1.0f, delta)
behavior.00bbd310_delta: The frame step does not consume the delta. The delta reaches only the layers.

00bbe8b0_scroll.rule: scroll(layer+1B8h..1C0h) += direction * delta * speed * 30.0f, then the node is placed at worldPosition(layer+120h) + scroll through virtual +30h
00bbe8b0_scroll.speed_source: 00BBDD70 on the same object, returned in ST0
00bbe8b0_scroll.constant: double 30.0 at 00CE7630, loaded as a double and stored as a float, which rounds once; a float multiply by 30.0f is equivalent
00bbe8b0_scroll.precondition: the block runs only when the distance fade leaves 1 - t != 0

behavior.00bbe8b0_fade: Distance between the layer's world position and the reference node's world position, minus a radius from 00BC3010, clamped as (distance - _DAT_00CF0DD8) / _DAT_00D20198 into [0,1], drives 00B6DA70(layer+1C4h * (1 - t), 0).
00867ee0: phase 1: for every non-null entry of the array at +10h/+14h, 00867D00(ECX = entry, delta, node)
phase 3: for every entry, 00867790(ECX = entry, delta, node) then the retire test
behavior.null_guard_idiom: NEG/SBB turns the pointer into 0 or -1 and TEST reg, 0xE186EC (0xE19AB0 in 00867790's inner loop) uses a global's address as an always-non-zero mask, so the test reduces to a null check. The decompiler renders it as (-(uint)(p != 0) & 0xe186ec) != 0.
behavior.00867ee0_retire: entry+09h != 0 and entry+1Ch <= 0 and entry+0Ah == 0 and every pointer in entry+0Ch/+10h is null, then 0081B010(ECX = this+10h, &iterator) erases the entry. The iterator is not advanced after an erase and the loop reloads data and size from +10h/+14h every pass.
00867d00: if instance+8Ch holds an attachment: attachment+44h == 0 refreshes its world matrix and pushes Matrix_Multiply4x4(local, attachment+F0h) through virtual +34h of instance+110h; attachment+44h set means it died, so 0042D9A0(0), 00867B10 and instance+09h = 1

if instance+28h or +2Ch is set: t = instance+48h + delta; when instance+4Ch < t, shift +3Ch..+44h into +30h..+38h, latch the new world position from instance+110h's row +120h, and when instance+88h > 1 and delta > 0 write velocity = (current - previous) / t into +5Ch..+64h if +28h is set and displacement = current - previous into +68h..+70h if +2Ch is set; then reset instance+48h to zero. Otherwise store t.
behavior.00866c60: Publishes the arguments into _DAT_00F87608 (delta) and DAT_00F8760C (node), walks the second array at +1Ch/+20h and dispatches each entry through 004C1130()'s +04h object, virtual +04h, then one virtual +08h with argument 1. Reads as per-frame draw or queue submission; not analysed further because 004C1130's object is render-side.
behavior.00867790: Walks entry+0Ch/+10h, calls virtual +28h with (delta, node) on every non-null child whose child+18h is neither 1 nor 4, then releases children that report themselves finished: virtual +08h returning non-zero, or child+0Ch clear, leads to virtual +30h, 00867320 and an InterlockedDecrement on child+04h.
behavior.008671a0: Drains the deferred-destroy std::list at +08h: per node, call the stored object's virtual +04h with argument 1 (the MSVC scalar deleting destructor), clear the slot, unlink and free the node.
behavior.004bcaa0: Returns immediately when DAT_00F8A2FC is null or its virtual +198h predicate is false. add true writes active+1 and total+1; add false writes active-1 floored at zero through an unsigned compare against 1 at 004bcad6 and leaves the total alone. Both stores go through ECX = game+650h at +F0h and +ECh, landing on game+740h and game+73Ch. Then 007FA1B0(ECX = game+650h, 0, 0x00BD53C0); 0x00BD53C0 points into .text, so it is a code pointer, not a string.

reconstruction.host: WorldOceanHost, one method per native call site in this slice; updates_between_ocean_and_effects exists only so a host preserves the native order of 00740E10, 0094C8F0 and 008EB110, which belong to other packets
reconstruction.rounding_note: length_00419440 rounds each square to a float, keeps xx + yy unrounded as the listing does, and takes the square root of the stored float.
